title: Whirlpool — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Whirlpool.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Every Day, Care." Whirlpool Corporation is the largest appliance manufacturer in the world. The Whirlpool brand itself sits at the heart of the portfolio — reliable, well-priced, and backed by the biggest service network in North America. Load & Go dispenser holds 40 loads of detergent, Wrinkle Shield keeps tumbling after the cycle ends, and their top-load washers outsell every competitor. Whirlpool is the safe choice that never disappoints.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: First-time homebuyers, rental properties, anyone who wants solid performance without overthinking it. The brand your parents trust.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Whirlpool:

• Load & Go holds enough detergent for 40 loads — just fill and forget

• Wrinkle Shield keeps clothes tumbling up to 12 hours after the cycle so nothing wrinkles

• Most service technicians in North America — easy to get repairs if needed

• Consistently rated most reliable by service companies and Consumer Reports

• FreshFlow produce preserver extends fruit and vegetable life in the fridge
